_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/quota.json (or set CLAUDE_QUOTA_FILE) and keep it current with `bash ~/.claude/enforce/quota-pace.sh record <bucket> <usedPct> --resets-at <iso>`. One bucket per weekly limit; `provider` groups buckets, and a provider's pace ratio is its worst bucket's. Timestamps are ISO 8601 with an offset or Z. Read by enforce/quota-pace.sh (IAN-603).
